description_en: The Pācāgaṇeśa shrine, located at the end of a street ascending westward from Mahāsnānaghara in Deopatan, houses one of the oldest Gaṇeśa statues in the region. Believed to date back to the 5th century (Michaels 1994, p. 83), the statue is of great historical significance.Constructed in theśikharastyle, the stone shrine features a tower adorned with 21 finials intricately carved into the stone blocks. The shrine derives its name, Pācu or Pācā Gaṇeśa, from its position at the end of an uphill path, aspāḥcārefers to a path that goes uphill or downhill. The surrounding area is known as Pācu Tvaḥ (ṭola), named after the uphill path. Standing guard on either side of the niche that holds the Gaṇeśa statue are a pair of majestic guardian lions.In the vicinity of the shrine, several other sacred artifacts can be observed. These include aśivaliṅga, a fragmented stone pillar, a Licchavicaitya, and fragments of smallercaityas. The stone pillar, which appears to be the lower section of a column from another temple, is currently inverted, as evidenced by the inverted ritual vessel (kalaśa) usually found at the bottom but now positioned at the top. Additionally, a large oblong stone revered as Bhairava is placed on a wall to the north of the shrine.The distinct features of the Pācāgaṇeśa statue, such as the two arms, large belly, and absence of ornamentation, along with its solitary presence without consorts or an animal mount, depict the deity in the half cross-legged (ardhaparyaṅka) posture. Notably, the tip of his trunk slightly turns left, resting on a pot filled with sweetmeats (modakapātra). These characteristics suggest that the statue originated between the 5th and 7th century, as mentioned by M. Khanāla (VS 2074, p.163).Unfortunately, there is no recorded historical information about the establishment of the shrine. However, a stone stele located southeast of the shrine bears an inscription dating back to 1821 CE (VS 1877). This inscription pertains to the construction of a road by a group of individuals.The temple premises and daily rituals at the shrine are maintained by a lady from the Adhikārī caste, hailing from Gaurīghāṭa. Additionally, she performs the daily rituals associated with the shrine. The residents of Pācu Ṭola have a tradition of paying homage to Pācāgaṇeśa before initiating any domestic rituals, considering him as the primary Gaṅeśa (sthānagaṇeśa) of the area. Furthermore, during the annual procession of Vatsaleśvarī, the palanquin of the goddess is intentionally brought into contact with the nearby Bhairava shrine, as confirmed by a local resident, an Adhikārī woman aged 47.
description_ne: उपत्यकामा पाइने प्राचीन गणेश मूर्तिमध्येको एक यस गणेश मूर्तिलाई पाचौँदेखि सातौं शताब्दीबीचको मानिएको छ ।यो गणेश देवल पशुपतिनाथको मूल ढोकाबाट पश्चिमतर्फ जयवागीश्वरी मन्दिर (PPK1212) तिर जाने पाचुटोलको उकालोमा रहेको छ । यो पाचुटोलको स्थानगणेश हो । नेवारभाषामा भिरालो बाटोलाई ‘पा:चा’ भनिन्छ । उकालोमा स्थापित गणेश भएकोले यिनको नाम ‘पाचागणेश’ रहन गएको हो । यहाँ स्थापित गणेशको मूर्तिलाई पाचौँदेखि सातौं शताब्दी बीचको मानिन्छ । शिखर शैलीमा ढुंगाका २१ वटा गजूर भएको सानो देवल बनाई गणेशको स्थापना गरिएको छ । देवलको दायाँ-बायाँ ढुङ्गाका सिंहहरू राखिएका छन् । देवल छेउमा एउटा शिवलिङ्ग, खण्डित स्तम्भ, लिच्छविकालीन चैत्य र साना चैत्यका अवशेषहरू राखिएका छन् । ढुंगाको उक्त खण्डित स्तम्भ कुनै अर्कै मन्दिरको थाम हुनुपर्दछ । थामको तल्लो भागमा रहने कलशको आकृति यहाँ घोप्टो परेको र यस स्तम्भको टुप्पोमा रहेकोले यो खण्डित स्तम्भ उल्टो पारी ठड्याइएको देखिन्छ । देवलको उत्तरीतिरको भित्तामा एउटा ठाडो ढुङ्गालाई भैरवको रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ ।पाचौँदेखि सातौं शताब्दीबीचका गणेश मूर्तिहरूका खास लक्षण भनेका दुई हात मात्र हुनु, पेट ठुलो हुनु, अलङ्करणरहित हुनु, अर्धपर्यङ्कासनमा हुनु, सुँड बायाँतर्फ केही घुमी देब्रे हातको मोदकपात्रमाथि अडेको हुनु, गणेशका साथमा अन्य परिवार सदस्य र वाहन समेत नहुनु आदि हुन् (M. Khanāla VS 2074, p.163) । यो गणेश मूर्तिसँग यी खास लक्षणरू मिलेको आधारमा यस गणेश मूर्तिलाई उपत्यकामा पाइने प्राचीन गणेश मूर्तिमध्येको एक मान्न सकिन्छ ।मूर्ति स्थापना सम्बन्धी प्रमाण मिल्ने कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन । देवलको दक्षिणपूर्वपट्टि विसं १८७७ (सन् १८२१) को एउटा अभिलेख ठड्याइएको छ । उक्त अभिलेखमा धर्मपुत्र प्रद्युम्न बाबा बलराम महत्तारी, शिवभक्त थापा आदिले बाटो बनाएको विवरण उल्लेख गरिएको छ । यो अभिलेख यस देवलसंग सम्बन्धित देखिँदैन ।ग‍ौरीघाट बस्ने अधिकारी थरकी एक महिलाले यस गणेशको सेवा गर्दै आइरहेकी छिन् । उनले दैनिक बिहान सरसफाई गरी मन्दिरमा साधारण पूजा गर्दै आइरहेकी छिन् । स्थानगणेश भएकोले टोलवासीले कुनै धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक तथा संस्कार गर्नुअघि यहाँ अनिवार्य पूजा गर्न आउने चलन रहेको छ । यस बाहेक वत्सलेश्वरीको जात्रा गर्ने क्रममा वत्सलेश्वरीको खट मन्दिर छेउको भैरवमा जुधाउने चलन रहेको छ (local resident, Adhikārī, female, age 47) ।

historical_events.event_description: The inscription on a stone stele standing southeast of the shrine appears to be unrelated to Pācāgaṇeśa. It deals with the construction of a road in the Paśupati area by a few persons. The text of the inscription is not fully legible.

In the name of the deceased Harimāyā Śreṣṭha, the large oblong stone (PPK1306-008) set on a wall north of the shrine was renovated by setting bricks around the stone. The stone is revered as Bhairava.
